atom_reviews.reasoning: Bovine subjects are clearly present and identifiable. However, taxonomy conformance is significantly penalized due to severe violations of diagnostic checkpoints: melted facial features with green drool violate 'Broad head with wide muzzle', fused/malformed legs violate 'Sturdy legs with cloven hooves', and indistinct neck/chest transition violates 'Thick muscular neck with prominent dewlap'. These are not minor issues but fundamental anatomical failures.

authenticity_review: The image exhibits severe AI generation artifacts that fundamentally compromise authenticity. Three central cows display unnatural viscous green/white substances dripping from mouths - this is not biological saliva but appears as melting wax or slime with impossible physics. Leg structures show catastrophic collapse: joints are undefined, hooves are missing or fused into grass texture, and some legs merge together without anatomical separation. Ear tags appear melted into fur rather than hanging as discrete plastic objects. While background lighting and grass texture are photorealistic, these structural hallucinations in the primary subjects make the image unmistakably artificial and biologically implausible.
key_defects: Count mismatch: 5 cows visible instead of requested 6
Attribute failure: Cows are pied/spotted, not checkered
Severe facial melting: Green/white viscous drool artifacts on multiple cows violating biological plausibility
Structural limb collapse: Legs lack defined joints, hooves fused/malformed/missing
Texture anomaly: Ear tags melted into ear tissue rather than discrete objects
Anatomical checkpoint failures: Broad head, sturdy legs, cloven hooves, thick neck all violated
